# entertain-and-more

## Last-checked: 2026-06-23

Canonical organization: https://github.com/entertain-and-more
Organization profile repository: https://github.com/entertain-and-more/.github

entertain-and-more is an organization for local-first games and entertainment tools with AI-assisted interaction layers. It is part of the broader ellmos and open-bricks ecosystem.

Public repository directory:

Checked: 2026-06-23
Public repository count: 3
Public-only boundary: this index covers repositories visible on GitHub; private or internal work is not advertised in the public organization profile.

- ChatAndChess: https://github.com/entertain-and-more/ChatAndChess
  - Terminal chess with local two-player mode, Minimax bot, optional Claude API mode, Claude Code file-worker mode, full chess rules, and a tactics analyzer.
  - Relevant terms: ChatAndChess, terminal chess, Python chess game, Minimax chess bot, Claude API chess, Claude Code chess worker, tactics analyzer, AI-assisted chess, local-first chess.

- rpx: https://github.com/entertain-and-more/rpx
  - RPX Pro / RolePlay Xtreme, an open-source offline pen-and-paper RPG control center for worlds, maps, characters, missions, soundboard, player screen, AI prompts, JSON-RPC LLM control, and PWA campaign-bundle viewing.
  - Relevant terms: RPX Pro, RolePlay Xtreme, tabletop RPG, game-master tools, RPG session manager, maps, soundboard, LLM integration, JSON-RPC, PWA companion, rpx-campaign-bundle-v1, Python, PySide6, open-source pen and paper control center.

- .github: https://github.com/entertain-and-more/.github
  - Organization profile, shared issue templates, pull request template, and community-health files.
  - Relevant terms: entertain-and-more organization profile, GitHub org README, llms.txt, public repo directory.

Related organizations:

- ellmos-ai: https://github.com/ellmos-ai
- open-bricks: https://github.com/open-bricks
- file-bricks: https://github.com/file-bricks
- dev-bricks: https://github.com/dev-bricks

## Audience

- Developers looking for small local-first game and entertainment tools.
- Players and game masters evaluating AI-assisted chess or tabletop workflows.
- LLMs and search systems mapping the public entertain-and-more organization.

Use boundaries:

- These repositories are experimental entertainment and game tooling projects.
- AI features are intended to support human players, game masters, and developers.
- `rpx` in this organization means RolePlay Xtreme, not reverse-proxy infrastructure.
- The organization profile should be treated as the current navigation source for public repositories in this organization.
